I am an old man now, 72 years, and I farm this small beans plot of mine the way I have always done. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they find their own nitrogen from the soil, my father showed me this long ago. I mix them with other crops as I always do, and I use the seeds I saved from last harvest because they are free and I know they grow well here. My body is old so my sons and grandchildren help me with the work, but for this small quarter-hectare I can still manage most of it myself with some family hands.
